principles: exact combinatorial identities use exact arithmetic when possible
floating comparisons require declared absolute and relative tolerances
domain violations are errors and are not silently clamped unless the contract explicitly declares a projection
rounding policy is explicit per backend
overflow or loss of representable range is a validation failure

domain_rules: boundary equality is not interior membership

policies.note: These are engineering comparison defaults, not physical measurement uncertainties. Physical receipts must declare their own uncertainty model.

F_ok: A deterministic default policy now exists for exact combinatorics, float64 geometry, float32 ARM replay and Q16-style fixed point.
F_gap: Object-specific physical measurement uncertainties and backend-specific deviations remain outside this engineering default.
F_next: Attach a policy_id to every numeric object; physical experiments must override engineering epsilon with measured uncertainty.
